name: interjection-genuine
why: The regression test that matters most. B genuinely interjects for 620 ms inside A's turn — in an interview a one-word answer is very often the most quotable thing in the file. Margin 0.90 and duration 620 ms, so BOTH guards independently refuse the flip. Fixtures interjection-short-but-certain and interjection-long-but-uncertain isolate them one at a time. The segment purity lands at 1100/1720 = 0.64, just ABOVE the 0.6 review threshold, so this segment is NOT flagged even though a second speaker genuinely spoke inside it: 0.6 was chosen, not measured, and this is the first concrete case showing what it lets through. Phase 5 tunes it against RTTM; recorded here so the number is visible rather than assumed.
